caption: The drawing depicts a single, bulbous pitcher with a wide base that tapers slightly inward and then flares outward at the rim, which features a pointed spout and a gracefully curved handle attached near the top and bottom of the pitcher. The pitcher is rendered in grayscale, with subtle shading to indicate light reflection and curvature, suggesting a metallic surface. The main body of the pitcher dominates the center of the composition, while a small schematic with dimensions is placed in the lower left corner, showing the object’s profile and providing measurements (approximately 7 3/4 inches wide, 9 inches high, and 15 1/4 inches from spout to handle). The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige, and there is a faint outline around the border. The artist's signature appears to the right below the pitcher.
title: Pewter Pitcher
